subject: BlueHarbor Security: SIG/CAIQ kickoff and clarifying items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor Security: SIG/CAIQ kickoff and clarifying items

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed next steps and a few clarifying questions so we can scope the questionnaire work and evidence collection.

Recap / what we shared on our side:
- Redwood can complete a SIG Lite or full SIG/CAIQ prefill depending on what you prefer.
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II and can share the latest report summary and control evidence where permitted by our compliance policy.
- For HIPAA/PHI customers we offer Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and can discuss a BAA.

Clarifying questions for BlueHarbor (please confirm):
1) Questionnaire scope: do you want a full CAIQ + SIG or SIG Lite (core controls) to start?
2) In-scope product(s): is this evaluation for the Hosted API only, or will Dedicated/Private be in-scope?
3) Compliance focus: you mentioned HIPAA earlier — do you require a signed BAA before we begin sharing any PHI-related evidence?
4) Evidence expectations: do you need raw artifacts (e.g., control evidence) or are control narratives and SOC 2 assertion sufficient initially?
5) Timeline: what is your target for returning the completed questionnaire (we typically aim to deliver a prefill within 5–10 business days once scope is agreed)?
6) Primary security contact for intake and procurement/legal contact for BAA/disclosure.

Attachments included: SIG-Lite-BlueHarbor.xlsx (spreadsheet w/ initial control map) — please confirm if you'd prefer the full CAIQ template instead.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm scope (SIG Lite vs CAIQ full) + in-scope products.
- We prepare the prefill and attach SOC 2 summary and any supporting artifacts we can share.
- If a BAA is required, we will loop in Legal and your procurement team to surface timelines.

If helpful, I can also schedule a short follow-up with Monica (our compliance lead) to walk through the SIG matrix line-by-line.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments:
- SIG-Lite-BlueHarbor.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Procurement <procurement@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor Security: SIG/CAIQ kickoff and clarifying items

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side:
- We will need a full CAIQ prefill in addition to SIG Lite — the vendor checklist requires the CAIQ for our security ops team.
- In-scope: Hosted API (production) only for this initial evaluation. We may expand to Dedicated later but not part of this intake.
- HIPAA/BAA: yes — because we will be sending PHI during the evaluation and proof-of-concept, a BAA will be required before we exchange any PHI or detailed patient-related artifacts.
- Evidence: initially we need the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and high-level control narratives; the security ops team may request specific artifacts (e.g., change control logs, encryption config screenshots) after the prefill.
- Timeline: ideally completed within 3 weeks; procurement would like an initial prefill within 10 business days.

Can you also confirm: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments, and what is your encryption-at-rest default for the Hosted API?

Also looping in procurement for BAA discussions.

Regards,
Alice Morgan
Manager, Security & Compliance
BlueHarbor Health
alice.morgan@blueharborhealth.com

---
BlueHarbor Procurement <procurement@blueharborhealth.com> has been cc'd to coordinate the BAA and commercial terms.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, BlueHarbor Procurement <procurement@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor Security: SIG/CAIQ kickoff and clarifying items

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick clarification. A few notes / answers below and next steps from our side.

Answers to your questions:
- CAIQ: we can deliver a full CAIQ prefill. We'll complete the spreadsheet and highlight any controls that are "partial" or "compensating."
- SOC 2: we will provide our SOC 2 Type II 2025 report summary and the assertion. Per policy we can also provide control-level evidence where reasonable; for anything restricted we will provide redacted artifacts or a control narrative.
- KMS/HSM and encryption-at-rest: for Redwood Hosted API we encrypt data at rest using AES-256 and manage keys via our cloud KMS; for Private deployments we support customer-managed keys via integrations with customer KMS/HSM (we can surface architecture details in the prefill).
- BAA: understood — we'll route BAA requests to Legal. Marissa, can you lead the BAA intake?

Requested items from BlueHarbor to accelerate work:
- Confirm the contact at procurement/legal who will handle the BAA (we've cc'd procurement but please share a dedicated contact).
- Any specific templates you want us to map into the CAIQ (if BlueHarbor uses a custom SIG/Excel, please attach).

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (summary), caIQ_prefill_instructions.txt (how we map our controls). We'll start the CAIQ prefill as soon as we have scope confirmation and procurement contact.

I can kick off a 30-minute walkthrough with Monica (compliance) and Marissa (legal intake) this week — propose Thursday 10:00am PT unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (application/pdf)
- caIQ_prefill_instructions.txt (text/plain)

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Procurement <procurement@blueharborhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 08:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor Security: SIG/CAIQ kickoff and clarifying items

Hi Karthik / team —

That all sounds good. Procurement contact for the BAA is:
- Jordan Lee, Senior Contracts Manager <jordan.lee@blueharborhealth.com>

We will require a signed BAA prior to exchanging any PHI; procurement will reach out to your legal team to coordinate.

We will proceed with a full CAIQ prefill. Attached is our vendor SIG template (we use a slight custom mapping) — can you map the CAIQ answers back to our template where possible?

Timeline: we aim to have an initial prefill from Redwood within 10 business days, with follow-ups to request additional artifacts as needed. If you can schedule that Thursday walkthrough with Monica and Marissa, that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to the prefill.

Best,
Alice
Manager, Security & Compliance
BlueHarbor Health

Attachments:
- blueharbor_vendor_sig_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
